highlights: Upgrade your grooming routine with the VGR V-987 Professional Hair Trimmer, the ultimate tool for precision and convenience.
Featuring an advanced ceramic and stainless steel blade, this trimmer ensures smooth, effortless cuts with every use.
Whether you’re at home or on the go, the V-987 has you covered with its impressive features:
Powerful Performance: Equipped with a high-speed 7000 RPM DC motor, the V-987 delivers exceptional cutting power for professional-quality results.
Extended Runtime: Enjoy up to 400 minutes of continuous use on a single 3.5-hour charge, thanks to the robust 2000mAh lithium battery.
Smart LED Display: Stay informed with the intuitive LED display that shows battery life in real-time (00-100%) and indicates turbo mode activation.
Versatile Charging: Charge effortlessly via the included USB Type-C cable, compatible with any 5V 1A adapter or power bank for ultimate portability.
Turbo Mode: Boost performance with the turbo function for thick or coarse hair, easily activated with a single button.
Travel-Friendly Design: The trimmer features a travel lock to prevent accidental activation. Simply press the power button for 3 seconds to lock or unlock.
Corded and Cordless Flexibility: Use the trimmer while plugged in or cordless for maximum flexibility.
Complete Grooming Kit: Comes with 3 guide combs (1.5mm, 3mm, 4.5mm), a cleaning brush, lubricating oil, a USB Type-C cable, and a protection cap to meet all your grooming needs.
